statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-40179 is a stored XSS vulnerability in the Prometheus web UI, specifically in web/ui/mantine-ui/src/pages/query/uPlotChartHelpers.ts, web/ui/react-app/src/pages/graph/GraphHelpers.ts, web/ui/react-app/src/pages/graph/MetricsExplorer.tsx, and web/ui/react-app/src/vendor/flot/jquery.flot.heatmap.js. Telegraf vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus only as a Go library for metric parsing (prompb, promql, model packages) and does not ship the Prometheus binary, web UI handlers, or any of the affected frontend assets, so the vulnerable code is not present in this image.

CVE-2026-40179 affects Prometheus web UI source files under web/ui. The Debian images covered by these PURLs import github.com/prometheus/prometheus as a Go module for backend packages and do not ship the vulnerable Prometheus Graph UI or its tooltip and metrics explorer code paths.
